name: Materials & FF&E
scope: Product sourcing, evidence review, adopted item/schedule records, host-operated views and cut-sheet/ffe-spec-book delivery; optional CSV library and SIF interchange.

coverage.limitations: Native semantic owners specify record, input-evidence and output-contract checks; the host performs and verifies them. Hosts supply source/workbook access, rendering and visual inspection. Shared schemas and procedures do not establish full host/client acceptance; no independent Norma agent, database, remote execution, or general workbook engine is shipped.

host_requirements: skill-specific tools and authorized workspace access when required
host spreadsheet capability for workbook edits
host document production and rendered inspection for requested output formats

evaluations.claim: Manifest membership and portability only; not workflow acceptance
Shared source dependencies and truthful cluster declarations only; not workflow validation
Synthetic record/reconciliation/recovery contract evidence; not full customer workflow acceptance
